title: A normal-symbol criterion for lower-dimensional modular reduction
exact_target: Determine when modular objects on Calabi–Yau threefold moduli can reduce to lower-dimensional forms.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002507 (AIM-PHYSICS-0015). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory, source item 3.3.

status_qualification: The source leaves the modular group, domain, notion of form and reduction map unspecified. The problem is to supply and investigate a meaningful reduction theory, not assert all such objects factor. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
